Name: Pam and Gus Get a Happy Ending
Author: teainthesunroom
Description:
[center][/center][center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/pCCgQxT.png[/img][/center]

[size=2][i][b]🌟 Feb 22, 2026: [/b]Version [s]2.1[/s] 2.2 is live! (Sorry! Found a bug that I caused during 2.1 edits.) See change log above. Please file bugs for any issues you find and I'll try to get it fixed. Thanks!
[/i][/size]﻿
[size=5][b]About this mod[/b][/size]

"Pam and Gus Get a Happy Ending" adds a series of "rival hearts" style events for Pam and Gus, showing their romance progressing from friendship to marriage and moving in. The heart event progression depends on your heart level with both Pam and Gus, and each event can only be triggered if the previous event has been viewed (so everything is shown to you in order and you won't miss anything). I focused on keeping everything canon-compliant and lore-friendly in both the events and the dialogue.

[size=5][b]Why Pam and Gus?[/b][/size]

I made this for myself because I wanted to see more of their relationship and how it could have been. I'm sharing it here because there might be other players who feel the same way. [i][size=1](I'm looking at you, authors of the four fics where this pairing is tagged on AO3!)[/size][/i]

I also hope this is the beginning of a "Rare Hearts" event series for some of the less appreciated residents and pairings of Pelican Town. [i][size=1](Does it count as "rival hearts" if neither of the participants were ever romantic options to being with...?)[/size][/i]

[size=5][b]Events[/b][/size]

Information about how to trigger each of the events in this mod, including day, time, location, and requirements.

[list]
[*]Event 1 [spoiler]Enter the [b]Stardrop Saloon[/b] any day between 6pm and midnight. This event won't trigger unless you have 1 heart with both Pam and Gus.[/spoiler]
[*]Event 2 [spoiler]Enter [b]town[/b] between 9pm and 2am on any sunny day except Wednesday or Sunday. This event won't trigger unless you've seen Pam and Gus's 1-heart event and have 2 hearts with both Pam and Gus.[/spoiler]
[*]Event 3 [spoiler]Enter the [b]Stardrop Saloon[/b] between 8am and 5pm on any weekday (not Friday, Saturday, or Sunday). The saloon doesn't open until noon, so you may not be able to enter until then. This event won't trigger unless you've seen Pam and Gus's 2-heart event, Gus's 3-heart event, and have 5 hearts with both Pam and Gus.[/spoiler]
[*]Event 4 [spoiler]Enter the [b]Stardrop Saloon[/b] any day between 6pm and midnight. This event won't trigger unless you've seen Pam and Gus's 5-heart event and have 6 hearts with both Pam and Gus.[/spoiler]
[*]Event 5 [spoiler]Enter the [b]Stardrop Saloon[/b] between 10am and 5pm on any weekday (not Friday, Saturday, or Sunday). This event won't trigger unless you've seen Pam and Gus's 6-heart event and have 7 hearts with both Pam and Gus.[/spoiler]
[*]Event 6 [spoiler]Enter [b]town[/b] between 10pm and 2am on any sunny weekday (not Friday, Saturday, or Sunday). This event won't trigger unless you've seen Pam and Gus's 7-heart event and have 8 hearts with both Pam and Gus.[/spoiler]
[*]Event 7a [spoiler]Enter the [b]Stardrop Saloon[/b] between 8am and 5pm any day of the week. This event won't trigger unless you've seen Pam and Gus's 8-heart event and Pam's official 9-heart event, have 10 hearts with both Pam and Gus, and have completed Pam's Community Upgrade. [b]Note: [/b]This event starts an irreversible series of events that end in Event 7c with Gus moving in with Pam. If you have a mod that gives Gus family members, they will not be moved in with Pam. I'm exploring workarounds for this.[/spoiler]
[*]Event 7b [spoiler]Enter [b]Pam's house[/b] between 8am and 12pm any day of the week. This event won't trigger unless you've seen the previous event (Event 7a) and still have 10 hearts with both Pam and Gus.[/spoiler]
[*]Event 7c [spoiler]Enter the [b]Stardrop Saloon[/b] between 8am and 2pm any day of the week. This event won't trigger unless you've seen the previous event (Event 7b) and still have 10 hearts with both Pam and Gus. [b]Note: [/b]1-2 days after this event, Pam and Gus's schedules will be altered, Gus will move in with Pam, and new dialog will start showing up.[/spoiler]
[/list][b]Additional information about Pam's official 9-heart event[/b] (includes spoilers for this mod and for the main game) [spoiler]After Pam's 9-heart event and the letter she sends you about Yoba, a few things change:

1) Pam's gift tastes are adjusted to no longer include alcohol. Alcoholic items (wine, beer, ale, etc) become "disliked" gifts instead of "loved" gifts and her previously "liked" gifts of vegetables and milk move up to her "loved" gifts to represent her growth; all other gifts remain the same.

2) Pam begins going to the chapel on Sunday mornings, so she won't drive the bus on Sundays (with 1.6 this is no longer a problem).

3) Pam's schedule becomes slightly less reliant on the saloon, and she doesn't go at all on Sundays.

4) Pam won't gift the player alcohol in the mail anymore.

5) Pam's general dialogue updates to adjust how she speaks about alcohol.

6) Pam's pale ale quest is updated to a parsnip soup quest. If the player already has the pale ale quest, the letter in your inventory and the quest in your journal/log will be updated for parsnip soup instead.

7) Penny's secret note will no longer include alcohol references.[/spoiler]

[b][size=5]Installation
[/size][/b]
To install this mod:

[list=1]
[*]Download the .zip file and open it. (If you're on Android, download the new "Android Beta" file in the Files tab.)
[*][size=2]Open your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder. If you downloaded a previous version of this mod, delete the folder "[CP] Pam and Gus Happy Ending" from your mods folder.[/size]
[*]Drag the folder "[CP] Pam and Gus Happy Ending" from the .zip file into your Mods folder.
[/list]
Important notes:

[list]
[*]If you were using a [b]v1 [/b]version of this mod in an existing game, you [b]should not replace it with a v2 [/b]version; it will likely break because the event naming changed to align with SDV 1.6 standards. If you do replace the very old version in an existing save, at the very least I may force you to go through the events again since the event IDs are unique, and at worst, it may break your save.
[/list][list]
[*]Theoretically, this mod should be fine to add to an existing save if you didn't previously have the mod installed, but I [b]strongly suggest[/b] installing it while your relationship with Pam is at 8 hearts or less. Some events, such as Pam's 9-heart event, need to be triggered with the mod already installed. Installing it after her 9-heart event may break the mod and do strange things to your save.
[/list][b][size=5]Config[/size][/b][size=5] [/size][i][size=2](none)

[/size][/i]This mod doesn't currently require config options. In the future, I'll add config options, but for now, there isn't anything to configure.

[size=5][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size]
This mod is probably not compatible with any mods that allow you to romance Pam or Gus, or allow Gus to have other family members living in the Stardrop Saloon with him. I'm working on improving this in future updates. For specific mods: 

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿: Fully compatible. 
If you choose the [b]Turkish Gus variant[/b] in the DSV mod config menu, ﻿some of my mod's heart events in the Stardrop Saloon will be automatically adjusted so that Emily serves the alcohol instead of Gus. If you turn on the [b]AroAce Gus[/b] option in the DSV mod config menu (regardless of which Gus variant you have selected), my mod will turn itself off automatically because its romantic storyline isn't compatible with DSV's AroAce option and dialog. If you deselect the AroAce option, this mod will turn itself back on. (I'm working on a platonic version of the storyline, to be included in a future update.)[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]: Generally compatible.
May be minor schedule bumping depending on which additional expansions you have installed. I'll be testing as many as I can and will update this list as I complete testing. For SVE, there are a few issues that have popped up in testing that will be fixed in the next mini update.[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6966]Community Center Reimagined[/url]: Compatible with adjustment.
The cooking class may cause problems due to Gus's schedule changes. I'm testing a compatibility update for this and will include in a future update. For now, if it's causing issues, you can turn off the "Cooking Class" option in the Community Center Reimagined mod config options.[/list][size=5][b]Translation[/b][/size]

[b]Note: Please DO NOT post AI translations of my mod. I will not knowingly promote or link to AI-translated content.
[/b]
I have fully internationalized the strings in this mod. They're located in the [b]default.json[/b] file in the [b]i18n folder[/b]. I don't expect many changes to existing dialog in the future, so hopefully strings are relatively stable now.

If you would like to translate it, please feel free to! Please set this mod as required when you post your translation on Nexus. Thank you![b]
[/b]
[size=5][b]Future Plans [/b][/size][i](tentative)

[/i]I'm constantly thinking of ways to improve the mod and these are just a few of the things you can look forward to:

[list]
[*]Add config options to move Gus back to the saloon, if preferred, or move Pam into saloon instead
[*]More family-oriented heart events for Pam, Penny, and Gus together (+ the farmer if married to Penny)
[*]More content around Pam's recovery from substance/alcohol use disorder and Pam and Penny working on their relationship
[*]Mocktails at the bar
[*]A platonic version of the mod with similar events based on friendship instead (will be compatible with AroAce Gus in DSV, as well as mods that make Pam and/or Gus available to date or marry)
[/list]

This mod was inspired in part by zoedoll's excellent [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9558]Ridgeside Rival Hearts - Jeric and Alex[/url] mod, as well as the amazing community of mod makers on the Stardew Valley discord server. Thanks to everyone leaving comments and filing bugs! And many thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS]AirynS[/url] for his helpful advice on how to add [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]DSV[/url] compatibility!

[i]No AI was used in the creation of this mod.
[/i]
[size=5][b]Trigger Warnings[/b][/size]

Drinking, being drunk and disoriented, alcohol use disorder (alcoholism)

[i][color=#cccccc]Note: This is a work of fiction. Fiction and reality are very different. It isn't meant to be an in-depth examination of alcohol use disorder or recovery/sobriety. It's focused on the relationship between Pam and Gus with some lightly recovery-related heart events that are more like glimpses into the process. It shouldn't be looked to for any kind of guidance around recovery or even as a good example of what that might look like in the real world.

If you or someone you love needs help with alcohol use disorder, you can call the SAMHSA National Helpline in the US for free, confidential help at 1-800-662-4357.[/color][/i]
